# PayShield GNN v1 — Model Card

**Generated:** 2026-08-01 12:09 UTC (auto-generated from `gnn_benchmark_results.json`)

## Model Details

- **Architecture:** HeteroConv + SAGEConv (mean aggr), 2 layers, hidden 64, global mean pooling + MLP readout
- **Parameters:** 53,826
- **Training data:** synthetic UPI generator (scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py)
- **Lead metric:** PR-AUC (measure of minority-class ranking quality)
- **Framework:** PyTorch + PyTorch Geometric (HeteroConv, SAGEConv)

## Intended Use

Primary: detect anomalous UPI transactions via relational graph patterns
(shared-device mule rings, merchant collusion) as a conditional fusion input
to PayShield's ensemble scoring engine.

Out of scope: stand-alone fraud verdicts; real-time payments with latency
budgets under 1 ms (the GNN path is ~2 ms p99); jurisdictions not covered
by PayShield’s EU AI Act conformity assessment.

## Evaluation Data

- synthetic UPI generator (scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py)
- 10,000 users, 1,000 merchants, 30,000 transactions
- Fraud prevalence: 5%
- Test split: 557 ego-graphs (44 positives)
- Seed: 42

## Test Metrics (held-out user-disjoint split)

| Metric | GNN | Edge-free MLP |
|--------|-----|---------------|
| AUC-ROC | 0.6666 | 0.4420 |
| **PR-AUC** *(lead)* | **0.1950** | 0.0518 |
| FPR @ 90% recall | 0.7135 | 0.9581 |
| **PR-AUC lift** | — | **3.8×** |

*Why PR-AUC leads:* AUC-ROC is dominated by the legitimate majority in
imbalanced fraud; PR-AUC measures the minority (fraud) class directly.

## Inference Latency (CPU)

| Statistic | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Mean | 0.4 ms |
| p50 | 0.4 ms |
| p95 | 0.4 ms |
| p99 | 0.4 ms |
| Max | 0.5 ms |
| Runs | 300 ego-graphs (median 48 nodes, 14 edges) |

## Known Limitations

- trained on synthetic data; real UPI traffic has different seasonality
- graph-level readout mean-pools all users in the ego-graph
- P2P recipients derived deterministically from merchant id (generator emits no recipient)

## Fairness Evaluation

Demographic performance slices (SPD / EOD) are computed by
`models/fairness_audit.py` on synthetic gender, age-tier, and city-tier
splits. See the audit script for the latest numbers — they are **not**
hardcoded here to ensure they stay current with every run.

## Graph Schema

- **Node types:** user (5 features), merchant (19 features), device (4 features), transaction (4 features)
- **Edge types:** user→performed→transaction, transaction→to→merchant, user→used→device, user→transferred_to→user, device→shared_by→user
